title: Sada Yeh Deti Hai Sughra ke Aou Aye Baba
body:
Sada yeh deti hai sughra ke aou aye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Kiya joh beti se wada nibhaou aye baba
1. Gham e firaq me muu aansou o se dhoti hoon {2}
Mai yaad kar ke bhare ghar ko aaj roti hoon
Na gham me tum mujhe ithna rulaou aye baba
<<MINI>>
Sada ye deti hai sughra ke aou aye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Sehen ke bich me jhula mujhe rulata hai {2}
Jo bhai rehta tha godi me yaad aata hai
Chale hai gudniyou Asghar bataou aye baba
<<MINI>>
Sada ye deti hai sughra ke aou aye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Watan se door rachaou jo bhai ki shadi {2}
Hoo muntazir mai lagaoungi aan ker mehendi
Ghareeb beti ko ab toh bulou aye baba
<<MINI>>
Sada yeh deti hai sughra ke aou aye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Nahi hai koi bhi hum jholiyou me saath mere {2}
Sambhale mujhko giru joh pakad ke hath mere
Bahen Sakina se ab toh milao aye baba
<<MINI>>
Sada yeh deti hai sughra ke aou aye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Akele pan me hai ab zindagi se bezari {2}
Hai aisa zouf ke rasha badan pe hai taari
Chacha ko bhej ke ab toh bulou aye baba
<<MINI>>
Sada yeh deti hai sughra ke aou aye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Taras gaye hai mere kaan ek sada ke liye {2}
Karam karo zara beti pe ab khuda ke liye
Azaan e akber e mehruu sunao aye baba
<<MINI>>
Sada yeh deti hai sughra ke aou aye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Kis haal me hai yeh sughra kabhi qabar lena {2}
Ek aur beti watan me hai yaad karlena
Rida joh behnou ko meri udhaou aye baba
<<MINI>>
Sada yeh deti hai sughra ke aou aye baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz:-Jawad Ali jouhar..
